note: Private family-run campground on the Thornapple River, Barry County, ~26 wooded acres; kayak rentals for registered guests. The operator says its focus is seasonal camping and longer-term RV stays, with weekly and monthly sites only occasionally available. --Claude
summary: Operator site: 2026 rates still list RV electric $40 / full hookup $60 / holiday $80, weekly $350, monthly $1,000, seasonal from $3,000, but booking is a request form with a 7-night minimum stay and the operator calls itself a seasonal / long-term park ('A limited number of monthly and weekly campsites may occasionally be available'). Recorded the 7-night minimum, request-form booking, season (last weekend of April - first weekend of October), water/sewer, pull-through, showers/laundry/dump. Note's 'reservable online despite a seasonal lean' was wrong and is removed. Phone 269-945-5166 matches. Fails the long-stay tests: see flags.
flags: Long-stay criteria: the reservation request form states 'Minimum stay is 7 nights' (https://whisperingwaterscampground.com/reservation/, read 2026-10-22), a standing minimum over the 3-night drop line; and the operator says 'Our focus is seasonal camping and longer-term RV stays ... A limited number of monthly and weekly campsites may occasionally be available based on space and seasonality, but the heart of Whispering Waters has always been the seasonal camping community' (our-campground page). No site is sold nightly (test 4 fails) and there is no booking engine (request form only). The rates page still prints $40/$60 nightly rates, which conflict with the 7-night form minimum. Seasonal share: not published, but described as the core of the park. Candidate for removal.
